netcdf fill-cdf2 {
dimensions:
	n = 3 ;
variables:
	byte b(n) ;
	char c(n) ;
	short s(n) ;
	int i(n) ;
	float f(n) ;
	double d(n) ;

// global attributes:
		:note = "unwritten variables keep their fill values" ;
data:

 b = -127, -127, -127 ;

 c = "" ;

 s = _, _, _ ;

 i = _, _, _ ;

 f = _, _, _ ;

 d = _, _, _ ;
}
